display_long_description:
RRVR is a chaotic, fun-filled game all about messing around, exploring, and just having a great time with others!

Customize your doggo however you want — with tons of cosmetics, your style is completely up to you.

Be sure to check out the game modes available right now, along with some exciting ones coming soon! (Not all game modes are available at launch.)

Don’t forget to read the rules and code of conduct so you know what’s allowed and what isn’t — stay cool and avoid consequences!

This game has been built from the ground up, and we couldn’t have done it without some amazing people:

Thatguyfr — Been here since the very beginning of RRVR!
Solkean — Created the model and is just an awesome person to be around.
Axolotily — Brought the music and maps to life — huge thanks!

And shoutout to our players and moderators:
Jacko, Poptart, and Floyd — we see you :)

Thank you for being part of this journey.
We hope you have an amazing time playing
